CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.novaesweb_connect_is_active_master()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.master_profiles p where p.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and p.is_active and p.role = 'MASTER');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.novaesweb_connect_is_active_store_member(target_store_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.store_members sm where sm.store_id = target_store_id and sm.user_id = (select auth.uid()) and sm.is_active);
$function$
